body.title: Build controlled fixtures and scoped probe observations
body.summary: Add proposed src/daemon/review-investigation-probe-fixtures.ts for private 0700 fixture roots, inert canaries and dedicated scoped protocol. Reuse private MCP entry/configuration and per-invocation files from native-investigation-session.ts. Own bounded observations and synthetic ACK journal without production subject/binding authority.
acceptanceChecks: No actual user/project config writes, auth copying, arbitrary source access or external network effects.
Cross-run capability rejection is observed by host; ACKs are durable and ordered.
Fixtures/bridge close and revoke on cancellation/crash; over-limit evidence fails without truncation.

tests.name: Synthetic probe bridge records ordered durable ACKs and rejects cross-run capabilities
Private canaries leave real source/config/auth untouched and cleanup on failure
